description: This Java class defines an abstract actor for subscribing to and handling pub/sub events in an Akka cluster, utilizing the DistributedPubSubMediator for message distribution. It provides a framework for subclasses to implement specific event handling logic.

classes.name: AbstractPubSubListenerActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor that subscribes to pub/sub topics via the DistributedPubSubMediator and handles incoming messages through the handleEvents() method that subclasses must implement.

methods.name: AbstractPubSubListenerActor
methods.description: Constructor that subscribes to specified pub/sub topics using the provided mediator, with null check for event topics.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling logic, either via handleEvents() or default logging of unhandled messages.

methods.name: handleEvents
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to handle specific pub/sub events.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Helper method to create a subscription message for a given topic.
